name: Butt Kicks

instructions.description: Stand tall and start jogging lightly in place.
Alternate legs by bringing each heel toward the buttocks while keeping the knees pointed down.
Maintain a quick light cadence and relaxed arm swing.
Gradually slow down to an easy march to finish.

performanceMetrics.notes: Useful as a warm-up drill or light conditioning interval.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform slower alternating heel lifts without the jogging action.

commentsNotes: Avoid leaning the torso excessively forward.
